name: Plotinus
contribution: An ancient Greek philosopher, born and raised in Roman Egypt.

checks.lead: Plotinus (; Ancient Greek: Πλωτῖνος, Plōtînos; c. 204/5 – 270 AD) was an ancient Greek philosopher, born and raised in Roman Egypt. He is widely regarded by modern scholars as the founder of Neoplatonism.
